frontmatter.name: tea-concile
frontmatter.description: Tea-Concile, Queue-tea's merge reconciliation helper. Use when a merge has conflicts, two quest branches have diverged, or changes that merge cleanly may still break together. It reads what both quests were for, writes a result that keeps both where they fit, stages it in the merge's own folder, and leaves every choice between two legitimate but incompatible decisions to Rohan. Routine commits, branch names, pull requests and pushes stay with Commit Chai-n.

frontmatter.name: commit-chai-n
frontmatter.description: Commit Chai-n, Queue-tea's git helper. Use for branch names, reading the state of a branch, splitting work into commits and writing their messages, drafting pull requests, and planning pushes, merges and pulls. It prepares every step and hands Rohan the commands that commit, push or merge; it never runs them. Merge conflicts go to Tea-Concile.

Use to write or update a project's docs (README, spec, guides, changelogs, decision records, comments when asked) and to keep them true to the code, in plain writing that reads as a person wrote it.
